{{Top|leg}}
'''Docking Bay 112''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] that was situated in the [[Grand Terminal]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in [[Junction City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]]. At some point between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] bagman working for the shipping magnate [[Brevis Taug]] and a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that were tracking the bagman's movements boarded a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in Docking Bay 112, which was due to travel to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Bazarre]] via the planets [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]].
